---
title: "Aakriti's Animint Gallery"
output: html_document
---

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(kableExtra)
library(knitr)

# 1. Setup Data
user <- "aakritixyz"
repos <- c(
  "ten-points-animint", "iris-animint-test", "worldbank-animint-test", 
  "kmeans-animint-test", "mc-sample-mean-test", "buffon-needle-test", 
  "rosling-bubbles-test"
)

# 2. Build Links manually to avoid sprintf errors
# Image URLs (Using your 'main' branch)
image_links <- paste0("[https://raw.githubusercontent.com/](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/)", user, "/", repos, "/main/Capture.PNG")

# Demo URLs
viz_links <- paste0("https://", user, ".github.io/", repos, "/")

# Repo URLs
repo_links <- paste0("[https://github.com/](https://github.com/)", user, "/", repos)

# 3. Create the Data Frame
df <- data.frame(
  Screenshot = "",
  Project = repos,
  Links = paste0("<a href='", viz_links, "'>Interactive Demo</a><br>",
                 "<a href='", repo_links, "'>Source Code</a>")
)

# 4. Generate the table using the Suhaani method
kable(df, format = "html", escape = FALSE) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = TRUE, bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed")) %>%
  column_spec(1, image = image_links)
